propose.normative_voice: A Business-System Bridge is a typed, source-bound alignment between capability-local business meaning and system-runtime meaning that preserves distinct identities, owner routes, predecessor digests, allowed readings, forbidden collapses, and a validation route.

propose.plain_language_voice: It is the checked translation table between what CyberAlchemy means and what the runtime model says, without pretending the two are the same thing.
propose.domain_context_voice: For ontology integration it connects Context selection and product rules to the generated runtime ontology; it is not the Rust adapter or the event store.

specialize.narrower_context: Ontology-runtime projection resolution for one existing CyberAlchemy Context.
specialize.normative_voice: A Context Selector is an immutable request owned by one Context that names one semantic cursor, required subject set, governance join policy, intended use, and projection profile.
specialize.formal_voice: ContextSelector = (selector_id, context_ref, semantic_cursor, required_subject_ids, governance_join_policy, intended_use, projection_profile, owner_route).
specialize.plain_language_voice: It says exactly which ontology state a Context wants to see and how that view must be joined and rendered.
specialize.domain_context_voice: The integration adapter accepts only registered selectors; arbitrary paths, mixed cursors, or caller-selected replay sources fail closed.

specialize.narrower_context: A consistent ontology state calculated at one graph-wide monotonic cursor.
specialize.normative_voice: A Canonical Event Cut is the complete gap-free semantic event prefix through one graph-wide cursor together with every governance event required by the selected exact-join policy for subjects visible at that cursor.
specialize.formal_voice: Cut(c,J) = (E_sem[1..c], required_governance(E_sem[1..c],J)); valid iff cursors are unique and contiguous, event chains and digests verify, and every required governance reference resolves exactly.
specialize.plain_language_voice: It is one clean freeze-frame of the ontology: no missing events, no future events, and no governance borrowed from a different moment.
specialize.domain_context_voice: Every CyberAlchemy context projection is calculated from one such cut; mixing latest snapshots from different cursors is rejected.
specialize.boundary: It is not a mutable snapshot, wall-clock time, database transaction claim, migration admission, or authority decision.

specialize.narrower_context: A deterministic ontology read model produced from a Context Selector and Canonical Event Cut.
specialize.normative_voice: An Event-Calculated Projection is a deterministic derivative view produced only from a valid Context Selector and Canonical Event Cut, retaining the source cursor, source-event-set digest, selected identities, exact governance joins, allowed readings, and forbidden authority moves.
specialize.formal_voice: Projection = F(ContextSelector, Cut) and same_bytes(ContextSelector,Cut) => same_bytes(Projection). Projection contains (cursor,event_set_digest,subject_ids,relation_ids,governance_refs,view_digest) and cannot be an input event source.
specialize.plain_language_voice: Replay the same verified events for the same request and you get the same view; deleting the view never deletes the ontology history.
specialize.domain_context_voice: Machine views, human views, indexes, and latest-subject snapshots are rebuildable outputs of this calculation and are rejected as replay sources.
specialize.boundary: It is not canonical ontology input, a hand-maintained source, an owner decision, proof of admission, or an implementation acceptance.
